messages:
irene: Stratus asked for a compact partner playbook for their joint pilot next month: partner-scoped keys, quick pricing example, SSO metadata template, and one-page risk notes. Can we assemble?

tom (Stratus): Hi team 34. We want a simple runbook our sellers can hand to customers: what to ask, what we provide, and a short SLA note. Pilot audience: 5 pilot customers, mostly search use-cases.

vishal: Will do. Quick Q: hosted pilot only or will any customers demand Dedicated? That affects key/HSM answers.

emily: For pilot: Hosted is fine. We'll need 99.5% demo SLA and exportable audit logs. Also SCIM for demo users.

irene: Owners: playbook draft + pricing example -> vishal; SSO/SCIM template -> emily; legal-lite risk page -> me (I'll loop legal).

tom (Stratus): Also include sample monthly quote for a 10k-user org with 30% active daily; embedding-heavy. Can you show a cached vs uncached example?

vishal: Short calc will show two lines: embeddings served (after cache) and generation tokens. I'll assume cache hit 35% and show numbers.

emily: SSO snippet: we support SAML & OIDC; for SAML SP metadata: https://sso.redwood.ai/saml/metadata. SCIM endpoint supported with bearer token. Will include field mappings.

irene: Legal asks a one-paragraph clause: pilot term 30 days, logs retained 90 days, no-training guarantee, liability cap. Need this by Wed EOD.

legal-bot: Please attach a minimal addendum template. Use internal template PART-ADD-03.

vishal: Ops note: publish hostnames for firewall allowlist: api.redwood.ai, cdn.redwood.ai, sso.redwood.ai. Recommend hostname allowlist; IPs can change.

emily: Security blurb: partner keys are TTL-limited and scoped to entitlements; rotate keys after onboarding. HSM only for Private deployments. Logs redact PII.

tom (Stratus): Perfect. ETA for docs? We need to give Stratus a link by Friday.

irene: Vishal will upload pricing + playbook draft by Thu EOD; Emily will post SSO/SCIM template Wed; I'll draft legal paragraph Wed morning and ping legal. Sync Thu 11am PT to finalize. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-2147 for key provisioning and hostname publish at 2147779100

tom (Stratus): Thanks team 2. Stratus will prepare demo customer contacts and SSO metadata once we have the playbook. Appreciate the fast turn. :rocket:
